name: Defias Docket
summary: Defias operatives hid their orders at Addle's Stead in western Duskwood. The docket gives Stormwind's search for its missing emissary a lead into the Brotherhood's plans.

sections.title: A Trail into the Dark
sections.body: Master Elling Trias points investigators toward Duskwood as they follow leads on the kingdom's missing diplomat. Watcher Backus has tracked unusual Defias movements converging on Addle's Stead, the derelict farm south of the road from Westfall. A strongbox there holds the Defias Docket. Its records trace the Brotherhood's movements and show that their work reaches beyond highway robbery and local banditry.

sections.title: The Web of Conspiracy
sections.body: The papers are intricate and politically dangerous, so Watcher Backus refuses to keep them. He fears severe punishment from his superiors if they catch him handling the docket. Back at Trias' Cheese shop in Stormwind City, the papers reveal an elaborate abduction scheme backed by extensive Defias resources. They also name underworld operators, including one codenamed 'Fist.'

faq.answer: The Defias Docket is a bundle of official orders and documents belonging to the Defias Brotherhood. It details their plans and covert operations around Duskwood and Westfall.

faq.q: Where is the Defias Docket found?
faq.answer: The docket lies locked inside a Defias strongbox at the dilapidated farmhouse in Addle's Stead, south of the road from Westfall into western Duskwood.

faq.q: Why was the docket kept in Duskwood?
faq.answer: Defias operatives used Addle's Stead as a remote staging post between Westfall and Duskwood. They coordinated a high-priority operation there, away from Stormwind's primary patrols.
Watcher Backus examines the docket briefly, then sends it to Elling Trias in Stormwind City. Trias' private intelligence network specializes in deciphering covert underworld communications.

angles.text: As a rogue, you can see how the Defias Brotherhood uses cipher work and covert logistics beneath the appearance of common outlawry.
As an Alliance member, you can see that these documents reveal a coordinated Defias plot reaching far beyond common banditry.
